title: Tightening Regulations on Digital Payment Token Service Providers
what_it_is: Tightening Regulations on Digital Payment Token Service Providers

sections.label: MAS cryptocurrency credit card warnings
sections.summary: MAS warns cryptocurrency dealing is risky, prohibits digital payment token providers from offering credit or leverage to retail customers, and says regulation cannot insulate consumers from losses.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Culture, Community and Youth and Trade and Industry (Mr Alvin Tan) (for the Prime Minister and Minister for Finance)
sentences.text: The Monetary Authority of Singapore (MAS) has consistently issued public warnings that dealing in cryptocurrencies is hazardous, highly risky and not suitable for the general public.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Culture, Community and Youth and Trade and Industry (Mr Alvin Tan) (for the Prime Minister and Minister for Finance)
sentences.text: If an individual uses his credit card to purchase cryptocurrencies, he could be borrowing from the credit card, which attracts a higher rate of interest than other forms of credit.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Culture, Community and Youth and Trade and Industry (Mr Alvin Tan) (for the Prime Minister and Minister for Finance)
sentences.text: If the value of the cryptocurrencies fall, he may suffer substantial losses and be unable to pay off his credit card debt, with the higher rate of interest compounding his debt.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Culture, Community and Youth and Trade and Industry (Mr Alvin Tan) (for the Prime Minister and Minister for Finance)
sentences.text: MAS has therefore prohibited digital payment token service providers from providing credit or leverage to all retail customers, regardless of age, for the purchase of cryptocurrencies.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Culture, Community and Youth and Trade and Industry (Mr Alvin Tan) (for the Prime Minister and Minister for Finance)
sentences.text: This includes restrictions on their acceptance of credit cards.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Culture, Community and Youth and Trade and Industry (Mr Alvin Tan) (for the Prime Minister and Minister for Finance)
sentences.text: MAS cautions that regulatory measures cannot insulate consumers from losses associated with the inherently speculative and highly risky nature of cryptocurrencies.

sections.label: Cross-border cryptocurrency prohibition concerns
sections.summary: Cryptocurrency trading and services are cross border, and a prohibition could lead consumers to unlicensed exchanges where they might not be properly informed of risks.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
sentences.text: With regard to the banning of cryptocurrencies, the Member would understand and realise that cryptocurrency trading and services are cross border in nature.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
sentences.text: In fact, as the Member alluded to, imposing a prohibition could likely lead to some consumers turning to unlicensed cryptocurrency exchanges to access cryptocurrency services, where consumers might not be properly informed of the risks to make well-informed decisions.
